title: Your Qualified Meeting Engine - 3 ICPs, 60 Inboxes, Booked Calls

sections.label: 1 - INBOX HEALTH ON YOUR 30 DOMAINS AND 60 INBOXES
sections.note: Nothing sends from an inbox that is not healthy. Warmup stays on, every inbox has a daily cap, and an inbox that slips comes out of rotation until it recovers.

sections.label: 2 - CLAY LISTS FOR YOUR 3 ICPS
sections.note: One Clay table per ICP. Every contact is a decision-maker, verified, and suppressed against your clients and anyone already contacted.

sections.label: 3 - COPY PER ICP, SPINTAX AND FOLLOW-UPS
sections.note: Plain text, short, one ask. Each ICP gets its own sequence and two angles, with spintax so no two emails read the same to a spam filter.

sections.label: 4 - LAUNCH AND TEST IN SMARTLEAD
sections.note: Low volume first, then A/B by ICP and angle. Reply rate decides what gets cut and what gets more inboxes.

sections.label: 5 - QUALIFIED BEFORE ANY CALENDLY LINK GOES OUT
sections.note: Every positive reply is checked against your qualified-meeting definition. Only a match gets the link, every booking carries its notes, and you get a report every week.
